method: Place N equally spaced nails on a circle of diameter d, with nail 1 at the top and numbering clockwise. For each zero-based nail i, form the straight connection from i to (i × multiplier) mod N. Omit zero-length connections and keep only one of each unordered duplicate pair. Adjacent nail spacing is the chord d × sin(π/N), rounded to six decimal places for display. The square SVG has a 12 mm margin on every side of the nail circle; key labels mark every ceil(N/12) nails, or labels can be off or on every nail. Coordinates are rounded to six decimal places. The guide lists each retained connection in ascending starting-nail order. Thread tension, wrap allowance, material quantities and structural board design are outside the model.
